The lowest $T _ { \mathrm { g } } = 3 1 4 . 7$K showed copolymer IZO-3/50 MB, having long aliphatic spacer chain and high content (50%) of nonchromophoric co-monomer.
The flask content was heated under reflux and ${ \bf N } _ { 2 }$atmosphere for 72 h.
The polymers and copolymers were obtained by radical polymerization of the monomers 2.1.6–2.1.12 in the presence of AIBN (10% by weight towards monomers).
The reaction mixture was then poured into water and the formed precipitate was washed several times with fresh portion of water. The product was dried at 323–333 K.
UV-vis spectra were made using Diode Array Hewlett Packard Spectrophotometer 8452 and quartz cuvettes of 1 cm spectral path.

The UV-vis spectra were made for monomers and polymers in DMSO solutions. The maximum absorption band of both classes of materials was observed within wavelength in the range 440–460 nm (Tables 1 and 2).
